messages.author: c2e0ed8ce2d46eee
messages.subject: Advanced intercross and backcross design
parts:
Greetings,

I'm wondering if it is possible to analyze a specific type of cross on R/QTL. I realize the BCsFt tools allow for analysis of [a series of] backcrosses followed by [a series of] intercrossing. My question is: can one analyze a cross created by first a intercrossing for multiple generations and THEN backcrossing (say, once or twice)? It's clear that the resultant mapping populations between these two approached necessarily differs, as the former will contain all possible genotype combinations at any given locus (A/A, A/a, a/a) but the latter can only contain two (A/A, A/a). I'm just not sure how the new advanced crosses feature of R/QTL deals with that.

Cheers,
Yasir

R/qtl doesn't include code to handle that type of cross.
